source_message.text:
Regarding connector placement:
The main and sensor boards slide vertically into rails inside the enclosure, with both boards mounted so their long edge is at the top.
The main connectors with many pins should be placed along the long (top) edge of both boards, with none on the sides or bottom.
On the main board, J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG should line up with J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG on the sensor board at the same relative position along the top edge, allowing the inter-board cables to remain short and run straight between the two boards.

The key point is that, as you can see, they stand vertically. That means the cables will be easier to connect if they are on top, or on the sides in the case of smaller connectors.
